title: Verification evidence schemas
responsibility: Defines validated captures, measurements, component identities, budget findings and complete verification records.

outputs.name: captureSchema
outputs.description: Strict capture schema with evidence/state/kind, pass/fail status, path/hash/bytes/type/time and optional viewport, provenance, transcript, duration and served build.

outputs.name: scenarioResultSchema
outputs.description: Strict scenario result schema with tested revision, pass/fail/referenced status, optional origin record and state captures.

outputs.name: profileSchema
outputs.description: Strict machine-profile schema requiring identity, platform, architecture, CPU, positive core/memory counts and runtime.

outputs.name: budgetFindingSchema
outputs.description: Strict budget finding schema with unit/metric, supported verdict, nullable baseline/measured values and optional target/detail/differences.

outputs.name: componentVersionSchema
outputs.description: Strict observed-component schema with change kind, target, manifest/source/contract/runtime digests and owned file hashes.

outputs.name: measurementSchema
outputs.description: Strict measurement schema with numeric or null value, method, unit, revision, nullable workload/profile, artifacts and optional unavailability, partiality, sampling and comparison context.

outputs.name: verificationRecordSchema
outputs.description: Strict version 1 complete record schema joining source/base, profile/tools, times/outcome, components, measurements, impact, tests, scenarios/builds, budgets, reasons, gates and failures. Each test may also include browser diagnostics with observed console errors or uncaught exceptions and declared expectations; omission remains valid for older records.
